statements: This map makes no location claim.
The Church takes no position on the geography of the book.
Every position on the page is a drawing choice.

questions.question: The Nephites build many cities on the north, one by the borders of the seashore in a particular manner. Pin it.
questions.label: p0127
questions.quote: which was in the north by the borders of the seashore

questions.question: You are Alma, sent out of Ammonihah with Amulek. Pin the land where you find the believers who were cast out.
questions.label: p0102
questions.quote: came out even into the land of Sidom

questions.question: King Mosiah wants news of the people who went up from Zarahemla to dwell in a land. Pin it.
questions.label: p0176
questions.quote: went up to dwell in the land of Lehi-Nephi

questions.question: Moroni conceals part of his army on the west of the river Sidon, and so down into the borders of Manti. Pin where.
questions.label: p0122
questions.quote: in the west valley, on the west of the river Sidon

questions.question: Alma travels from Gideon southward and meets the sons of Mosiah. Pin the land he is heading to.
questions.label: p0103
questions.quote: southward, away to the land of Manti

questions.question: You are Aaron. You journey to a land the Lamanites named after the land of their fathers' nativity, joining the borders of Mormon. Pin it.
questions.label: p0107
questions.quote: it was away joining the borders of Mormon

questions.question: After twelve days in the wilderness, Alma's people arrive and king Mosiah receives them with joy. Pin the land.
questions.label: p0063
questions.quote: twelve days they arrived in the land of Zarahemla

questions.question: You are one of the people of Ammon. Pin the land the Nephites give you, on the east by the sea.
questions.label: p0117
questions.quote: the land of Jershon, which is on the east by the sea

questions.question: The Jaredite armies pitch their tents by waters whose name means large, or to exceed all. Pin them.
questions.label: p0327
questions.quote: the waters of Ripliancum, which, by interpretation, is large, or to exceed all

questions.question: The Lamanite armies find the priests of king Noah tilling the ground. Pin the place, named for their leader.
questions.label: p0114
questions.quote: in a place which they called Amulon

questions.question: You are Mormon. Your people are driven northward until you reach a land. Pin it.
questions.label: p0364
questions.quote: we had come northward to the land which was called Shem

questions.question: You are young Mormon. Ammaron tells you where he hid the records. Pin the hill.
questions.label: p0166
questions.quote: a hill which shall be called Shim

questions.question: Moroni conceals part of his army on the east and south of a hill. Pin the hill.
questions.label: p0121
questions.quote: on the east, and on the south of the hill Riplah

questions.question: You are Omer, warned in a dream to leave. You flee past the hill Shim to a place by the seashore. Pin it.
questions.label: p0317
questions.quote: a place which was called Ablom, by the seashore

questions.question: The land on the north was called Desolation. Pin the land on its south.
questions.label: p0064
questions.quote: the land on the southward was called Bountiful

questions.question: Pin the land above Zarahemla, in the course of the land of Nephi, where Alma's spies see the Amlicites join a Lamanite army.
questions.label: p0091
questions.quote: in the land of Minon, above the land of Zarahemla

questions.question: The Amlicites come upon a hill east of the river Sidon and begin to make war. Pin the hill.
questions.label: p0088
questions.quote: the hill Amnihu, which was east of the river Sidon

questions.question: You are Alma, cast out of Ammonihah. Pin the city you set out for.
questions.label: p0099
questions.quote: took his journey towards the city which was called Aaron

questions.question: You are Corianton. You forsake the ministry and go over into a land among the borders of the Lamanites. Pin it.
questions.label: p0120
questions.quote: did go over into the land of Siron among the borders of the Lamanites

questions.question: You are Ammon, sent to find Zeniff's people. After forty days you pitch your tents on a hill. Pin it.
questions.label: p0177
questions.quote: a hill, which is north of the land of Shilom

questions.question: The Nephites found a city between the city of Moroni and the city of Aaron. Pin it.
questions.label: p0126
questions.quote: between the city of Moroni and the city of Aaron

questions.question: You are Hagoth. Pin the sea you launch your ship into.
questions.label: p0257
questions.quote: launched it forth into the west sea

questions.question: You are Mormon. You march to a land in the borders west by the seashore. Pin it.
questions.label: p0169
questions.quote: land of Joshua, which was in the borders west by the seashore

questions.question: You are Alma. You cross to the east of the river Sidon to preach. Pin the valley you reach.
questions.label: p0090
questions.quote: into the valley of Gideon

questions.question: You are Alma, done preaching in Melek. You travel three days north. Pin the city you reach.
questions.label: p0098
questions.quote: traveled three days’ journey on the north of the land of Melek

questions.question: Pin the river that ran by the land of Zarahemla.
questions.label: p0089
questions.quote: the river Sidon, which ran by the land of Zarahemla

questions.question: You are Teancum. You march down by the seashore to lure the Lamanites out of a city. Pin that city.
questions.label: p0131
questions.quote: on the west of the city Mulek

questions.question: Survivors flee to a city in the borders by the seashore, near the city of Desolation. Pin it.
questions.label: p0171
questions.quote: the city Teancum lay in the borders by the seashore

questions.question: Pin what divided the land of Nephi from the land of Zarahemla.
questions.label: p0255
questions.quote: divided from the land of Zarahemla by a narrow strip of wilderness

questions.question: King Noah's high tower overlooks a land possessed by the Lamanites. Pin it.
questions.label: p0111
questions.quote: land of Shemlon, which was possessed by the Lamanites
